teaser: Emails from my agents are from me: the Wizard of Oz in reverse, an article behind every answer, and an email where every line buys the next.
core_idea: People mistake agent-drafted emails for a chatbot, but every one is read, changed and sent by Dinis; behind most answers sits an article written once and linked many times, which is how long answers scale; and since each part of an email buys the next, the first email should open with plain text and the short answer, the banner and detail below.
